calculator.title: Avion-PEPT Calculation
calculator.intro: Estimate the average molecular mass of a linear peptide from its one-letter amino-acid sequence.
calculator.hint: Enter up to 400 standard amino-acid codes. Spaces and line breaks are ignored.
calculator.invalid: Use only the 20 standard one-letter amino-acid codes (A, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, K, L, M, N, P, Q, R, S, T, V, W, Y).
calculator.emptyResult: Your result will appear here when a valid sequence is entered.
calculator.calculationNote: Estimate for an unmodified, linear sequence, including terminal water mass. Cyclization, salts, terminal modifications, and measured batch composition can change the result.
calculator.disclaimer: For laboratory research calculations only. This tool does not calculate doses, solution concentrations, or administration instructions. It is not for human or animal use. Verify calculations with qualified laboratory references.
